newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Morgan Stanley starts pipeline cos.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Morgan Stanley starts pipeline cos.

text.p: -- Morgan Stanley said it began coverage of pipeline stocks on Wednesday, with analyst Dennis Higgins initiating Tejas Gas Corp and Enron Corp with outperform ratings.
-- El Paso Energy Corp and Williams Cos Inc were rated strong buy and TransCanada PipeLines Ltd got a neutral rating.

-- Higgins said in general, "It's a continued earnings growth story for the coming year because of consolidation in the industry ... A lot of the companies have recently completed major acquisitions, so I see very strong earnings growth playing out in the industry over the next year."
-- Tejas Gas Corp shares closed at 43-3/4.
-- El Paso Energy shares closed at 45-3/4.
-- Williams Cos Inc shares closed at 54-5/8.
-- TransCanada PipeLines Ltd were flat at C$23.15 on the Toronto Stock Exchange.
